title: David Zaslav Praises Gerhard Zeiler During Merger Transition
excerpt:
Zaslav recalled employee uncertainty before the Skydance deal closed.
He honored Zeiler's efforts at the International Emmys.
body_md:
Former Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav reflected on the difficult regulatory review of the roughly $110 billion Skydance merger at the International Emmys in New York. Presenting former international chief Gerhard Zeiler with the Directorate Award, he recalled employees' concerns about their jobs and families.

While Zaslav focused on the transaction, Zeiler began visiting international offices to meet staff personally. Within approximately one month, he had visited 15 locations, seeking to maintain direct contact during a period of uncertainty.

Zaslav also praised Zeiler's advocacy for local programming across HBO Max's international markets. Rather than relying solely on its American catalog, the company developed local programming, sports and news to remain relevant to regional audiences.

Zeiler stepped down following the merger and chose to enter politics in Austria. In his acceptance remarks, he emphasized continuous learning and understanding cultural differences throughout his career.
